zh: 两圆的关系只取决于圆心距d与两半径之和、之差的大小关系；圆心重合是需要最先单独判断的特殊情况。
为避免开方带来的精度问题，直接比较平方：把d²与(R+r)²、(R−r)²比较即可，因为非负数取平方不改变大小顺序。
每组先算d²：为0输出Concentric；等于(R+r)²或(R−r)²输出Touching；大于(R+r)²输出Disjoint-Outside；小于(R−r)²输出Disjoint-Inside；其余输出Intersecting。坐标和半径不超过5000，平方用整数即可精确计算。
en: The relation between two circles depends only on how the center distance d compares with the sum and the difference of the radii; coinciding centers are a special case to check first.
To avoid precision problems from square roots, compare squares directly: compare d² with (R+r)² and (R−r)², since squaring non-negative numbers preserves their order.

For each pair compute d² first: if it is 0 print Concentric; if it equals (R+r)² or (R−r)² print Touching; if it is greater than (R+r)² print Disjoint-Outside; if it is less than (R−r)² print Disjoint-Inside; otherwise print Intersecting. Coordinates and radii are at most 5000, so integer squares are exact.

explanationEn:
## Approach

First check whether the centers coincide; otherwise compare the squared distance between the centers with the square of the sum of the radii and the square of their difference.

## Proof of correctness

The two circles' boundaries meet exactly when |R−r| ≤ d ≤ R+r; equality at either end is exactly tangency, and the strict interior gives two intersection points; outside this range the circles are separate from each other or one lies inside the other. Squaring preserves order for non-negative numbers, and handling the concentric case separately avoids confusing coincident circles with degenerate cases.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(n) to store the output.
